observationBoundary.const: Twelve bounded cases replay the debug Map Test 0 prompt from one shared in-memory core state. A deterministic session-only copy of the verified ROM replaces the existing RunMapSetupInitFunction indirect call with a 16-byte FF-padding trampoline. The trampoline sets A6 to RAM-owned source-shaped input and JSRs one unmodified entity-population handler; the original disk ROM is re-hashed unchanged before launch. Lua writes only bounded ENTITY_INDEX_LIST records, selected ENTITY_DATA fields, CURRENT_MAP, GAME_FLAGS when the case requests it, and the input stream. It observes handler entry and return, every guarded direct callback in order, the script-cursor offset, selected identity-list and entity records, and the non-empty count over ClearEntities' 49-record span. It does not observe capacity beyond the 49-slot high-water case, normal-story/save/map-reload persistence, visible rendering/animation/VDP timing, collision, or pathfinding effects. All original handlers and callees execute in one BizHawk launch.
